The following events took place in '''3100 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Unidentified individual (Korsin)|former slave]] founded the [[Korsinite League]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], taking for himself the title [[Korsin (title)|Korsin]].<ref name="Pantheon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pantheon]]''</ref>
*The borders of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] were sealed, isolating the Consortium from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="TEA136">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> until [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="Courtship of Princess Leia">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> {{Circa}}<ref name="TEA136" />
